shop_description: Welcome to Archival & Arc Studio. We curate premium, high-resolution printable art — tactile Japandi plaster, moody Dark Academia oils, botanical studies, open-access vintage archives, and bold graphic posters with crisp typography. Instantly download at 300 DPI and print in 20+ frame sizes.

niches.name: Niche 4: Japandi Plaster & Clay Abstract Art
niches.summary: Tactile 3D-effect plaster textures, warm organic curves, arches, and minimalist geometric shapes using warm earthy neutrals.
niches.opportunity: High Demand / Low Supply. Saturated flat minimalist art is declining, but texture-driven printable plaster art is highly trending and has low competition.
niches.default_concept: minimal plaster arches, textured wabi-sabi wall art
niches.prompt_preset: painted abstract plaster texture art with organic arch shapes and subtle palette knife ridges, minimalist wabi-sabi Japandi design, warm neutral beige, clay, and soft off-white tones

niches.name: Niche 3: Moody Dark Academia & Gothic Oil Sketches
niches.summary: Somber, rich oil paintings featuring vintage subjects (moody forests, old libraries, classical owls, stormy sea cliffs) with heavy impasto strokes.
niches.opportunity: Very High Ticket Size. Dark academia fans are extremely passionate and prefer large gallery walls. Selling sets of 6 to 9 prints increases basket size to $15-$25.
niches.typical_format: Gallery Wall Bundle (Set of 6 to 9 Prints, Portrait & Landscape)
niches.default_concept: moody classic barn owl painting, vintage dark academia study
niches.prompt_preset: painted as a moody 19th-century Victorian oil painting sketch, dark academia library candlelit study, deep rich umbers and forest greens, chiaroscuro lighting, textured canvas brushwork

niches.name: Niche 1: Botanical Specimen & Vintage Nature Studies
niches.summary: Aged botanical and specimen-style illustrations — mushrooms, botanicals, butterflies — as pure visual art (no AI gibberish labels).
niches.opportunity: Evergreen Appeal. Educational and scientific vibes sell as gifts and dorm decor. Specific subjects beat generic "botanical print".
niches.default_concept: vintage wild mushrooms, botanical specimen illustration
niches.prompt_preset: detailed botanical specimen illustration in vintage lithograph style, aged distressed parchment paper background, natural plant forms only, precise linework, muted sage and sepia tones

niches.name: Niche 5: Public Domain / Open-Access Vintage Archive
niches.summary: Curate real museum open-access works (Met and similar) into printable packs — the honest version of mega-bundle vintage sellers.
niches.opportunity: Volume + SEO play. Competitors dump thousands of PD files cheap. You can start smaller: curated sets of 10–50 with better mockups and clearer themes (Still Life, Coastal, Warm Tones).
niches.typical_format: Themed pack (10–50 prints) delivered via PDF + Drive link

niches.name: Niche 6: Bold Graphic Posters (Real Typography)
niches.summary: Chilli-style dopamine / retro kitchen posters: strong silhouette + limited palette + crisp headline and tagline composited in-app (not AI text).
niches.opportunity: Design-forward singles at €8–12 beat commodity dumps on perceived quality. Easier branding, gifts, and trend keywords (70s, Y2K, dopamine decor).
niches.default_concept: single red chilli pepper, bold silhouette, yellow sun disc behind it, cream paper background
niches.prompt_preset: bold graphic poster illustration, limited color palette, high contrast silhouette, retro 70s print vibe, vintage paper texture
